name: 95358 · Modesto, CA
findings: ZIP 95358 (Modesto) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95358 (Modesto) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95358 (Modesto) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
